rationale.conceptual: The paper presents a custom method combining several advanced mathematical techniques (cofactors, characteristic roots, dual integral equations, Jacobi polynomials, Schmidt method). Translating the extensive analytical derivations into correct code requires genuine understanding of the paper's approach and careful handling of complex arithmetic.
rationale.execution: The workflow consists of two sequential stages: implement analytical helper functions, then solve the dual integral equations and compute intensity factors. It uses only numpy/scipy and produces a single JSON output; no complex orchestration or external data fetching is needed.
